content.body:
This guide covers mounting Vive 3.0, Tundra, Ultimate Trackers and Mocopi trackers to the StretchSense Studio Gloves. It has links to where you can obtain compatible mounts and the necessary required materials to make each attachment, as well as the mounting process.

> NOTE: We recommend using a third-party wrist strap to attach heavier trackers like the VIVE Ultimate Tracker. This helps to reduce the strain on the top electronics module while attached to the StretchSense Studio Gloves.

> TIP: Calibrate the gloves with the tracker attached for best results.
